_readme: Published installer manifest. Single source of truth for the version and SHA-256 the customer dashboard shows. Rewritten IN PLACE by the release job in the same commit that uploads the assets, so a manifest can never describe a build that was not released. Served at /build-manifest.json and read by GET /v1/me/entitlement. Until a release exists this file states `unavailable`; it never invents a version or a digest.
